summary: The FileManagement class handles the management of uploaded files, ensuring they are saved securely and potentially anonymized. It supports size validation, format checks, and organization within uniquely named folders.
purpose: To securely handle file uploads, ensuring they meet size and format requirements and are stored in a manner that avoids naming conflicts.

fields.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
fields.description: The maximum allowed file size for uploads, set as a constant.

fields.name: FileName
fields.description: The name of the file after handling, potentially anonymized.

fields.name: FileURL
fields.description: The URL pointing to the location of the saved file.

fields.name: FileSize
fields.description: The size of the uploaded file.

fields.name: FileType
fields.description: The type of the uploaded file.

fields.name: imgBinaryData
fields.description: Binary data of the image if the file is an image.

actors.name: HSPnetSession
actors.role: Maintains session context, including error messages.

workflows.name: HandleUploadedFile
steps: Check if the posted file is not null and not empty.
Ensure the file size does not exceed MAX_FILE_SIZE.
Validate image format if imgData is true.
Determine the NewFileName, potentially anonymizing it.
Create a new folder using a GUID.
Build the path for storage and save the file.
Return the file URL, size, and type.

business_rules: Image files must not be 32bpp CMYK if imgData is true.
validations: File size must not exceed the set MAX_FILE_SIZE.
Image format checks if imgData is true.
calculations: File size in MB is calculated by dividing MAX_FILE_SIZE by 2^20.
conditions: Anonymization occurs if the anonymize flag is true.
Image data is processed if imgData is true.
system_behavior: Creates a GUID-named folder for each file to avoid name clashes.
Saves files to the server with an optionally anonymized name.
exceptions: An error message is added if the file exceeds size limits or is a 32bpp CMYK image.
